autopilot.mission: Autonomously improve, ship, monitor, and grow managed projects toward their stated end goals with one efficient Solomon agent, preserving safety gates and proof.

name: example-repo

freshness.comment: Set no_objective until your repo has a real outcome metric. Fabricating a freshness emitter over a green test suite is the exact fake-green trap the gate exists to prevent.

goal: Replace this with your repo's improvement goal. Each iteration, make ONE real, high-leverage improvement: fix a genuine bug, harden error handling, improve reliability, or add missing test coverage. Keep tests green. A truthful 'nothing worth changing this cycle' beats a fabricated or cosmetic change.
